guard: The fixed-group npm census refuses partial, incomplete, or stage-only releases before any registry write
why: A sequential recursive publish cannot recover after one package version lands and a later package refuses.
npm OIDC HTTP 201 proves identity, not the direct-publish Allowed action. These mutations remove one fail-before-write property at a time and every one must be killed by the fake registry smoke.

mutations.name: an already-published exact version is treated as absent
mutations.expectRed: one already-published package refuses the whole preflight
mutations.cell: one already-published package refuses the whole preflight

mutations.name: a mixed present and absent census is allowed to continue
mutations.expectRed: one already-published package refuses the whole preflight
mutations.cell: one already-published package refuses the whole preflight

mutations.name: the recursive publish set may omit one fixed-group package
mutations.expectRed: one fixed-group package missing from the recursive publish set refuses
mutations.cell: one fixed-group package missing from the recursive publish set refuses

mutations.name: clean release skips per-package OIDC exchanges
mutations.expectRed: clean preflight exchanges OIDC for every package before publishing
mutations.cell: clean preflight exchanges OIDC for every package before publishing

mutations.name: a refused OIDC exchange is treated as ready
mutations.expectRed: one refused OIDC exchange refuses the full release
mutations.cell: one refused OIDC exchange refuses the full release

mutations.name: partial release begins OIDC exchanges before the complete registry census
mutations.expectRed: partial prior publish refuses before any OIDC exchange, trust GET, or publish call
mutations.cell: partial prior publish refuses before any OIDC exchange, trust GET, or publish call

mutations.name: an opaque HTTP 201 exchange is treated as direct-publish proof
mutations.expectRed: an opaque HTTP 201 exchange is not treated as direct-publish proof
mutations.cell: an opaque HTTP 201 exchange is not treated as direct-publish proof

mutations.name: a stage-only Allowed-actions sibling is allowed to continue
mutations.find: return n === "publish" || n === "npmpublish" || n === "createpackage" || n === "direct" || n === "directpublish";
mutations.replace: return n === "publish" || n === "npmpublish" || n === "createpackage" || n === "direct" || n === "directpublish" || n === "stage" || n === "npmstagepublish";
mutations.expectRed: one stage-only Allowed-actions sibling refuses the whole preflight
mutations.cell: one stage-only Allowed-actions sibling refuses the whole preflight

mutations.name: a non-401 trust read failure is treated as direct-publish proof
mutations.expectRed: a non-401 trust read failure still refuses before any publish call
mutations.cell: a non-401 trust read failure still refuses before any publish call

mutations.name: empty Allowed-actions lists are treated as direct publish
mutations.expectRed: classifier treats an empty Allowed-actions list as stage-only
mutations.cell: classifier treats an empty Allowed-actions list as stage-only

mutations.name: any GitHub publisher with createPackage proves this job can publish
mutations.expectRed: classifier ignores an unrelated GitHub publisher that lists createPackage
mutations.cell: classifier ignores an unrelated GitHub publisher that lists createPackage

mutations.name: GET trust claims identity is ignored
mutations.expectRed: classifier accepts official GitHub GET trust claims with createPackage
mutations.cell: classifier accepts official GitHub GET trust claims with createPackage

mutations.name: an exported signature changes without regenerating its declaration
mutations.replace:
export function trustUrl(registryBase, name, extra = "") {
  void extra;
mutations.expectRed: the committed .d.mts is byte-identical to a fresh emit from the module (run pnpm gen:npm-publish-preflight-dts)
mutations.cell: the committed .d.mts is byte-identical to a fresh emit from the module (run pnpm gen:npm-publish-preflight-dts)

mutations.name: a publisher with blank environment bypasses the environment check
mutations.replace: if (expectedEnvironment && envValue && envValue !== expectedEnvironment) return false;
mutations.expectRed: a publisher with blank environment refuses even with createPackage permission
mutations.cell: a publisher with blank environment refuses even with createPackage permission

mutations.name: the OIDC identity assertion ignores the environment claim
mutations.expectRed: an OIDC token without the environment claim refuses the whole preflight
mutations.cell: an OIDC token without the environment claim refuses the whole preflight

mutations.name: a 401 trust read under OIDC refuses the release again
mutations.expectRed: a 401 trust read under OIDC is recorded as unverifiable and does not refuse the release
mutations.cell: a 401 trust read under OIDC is recorded as unverifiable and does not refuse the release

mutations.name: an unverifiable trust read is admitted as createPackage proof
mutations.expectRed: a 401 trust read under OIDC is recorded as unverifiable and does not refuse the release
mutations.cell: a 401 trust read under OIDC is recorded as unverifiable and does not refuse the release
